profile.headline: Software Engineer at Radius Intelligence

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed APIs that allow Radius data repository to interact with the APIs of CRM and MAT tools such as Salesforce (Bulk API, Streaming API), Marketo, Eloqua, Pardot.
Designed (mostly as project lead) several micro-services using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data, native SQL and Elasticsearch queries that helped break up out initially monolithic application, allowing horizontal scalability with AWS tools: S3, Kinesis, Amazon Elasticsearch Services, Amazon RDS, etc. Provisioned most of them myself, (CI/CD included) using Jenkins, Terraform scripts and Kubernetes for scalability.
These microservices added a wide variety of functionalities: data enhancement, lead scoring, live synchronization with Salesforce, and custom exporting queries.
Wrote Python applications in order to help automate deployment, data extraction, and end-to-end testing. Maintained and enhanced the existing AngularJS web app.
Participated in Scala guilds, mentoring and code reviews.

positions.title: Senior Java, Full-stack developer
positions.description:
The Lending Club - San Francisco, CA August 2015 to July 2016
Java services/ AngularJS developer for the Small Business department, focusing on term loans and lines of credit for small companies in the 5K-300K range. Contributed in the design and creation of new functionality modules for this business, including branding for integration with commercial partners using our loan API, mail referral campaigns, a Direct Pay feature to pay off competitor’s loans, and the elaboration of the “Line of Credit” offer as a product separate from term loan.
Helped with the enhancement of the original AngularJS front-end application to support said features, and later with its migration to NodeJS. Created or enhanced dozens of REST APIs and endpoints for communication with the front-end. Interacted and collaborated with the DBAs in submitting queries, table designs, and Liquibase scripts. Participated in code reviews, Java brown-bags, design spikes, production issues diagnoses using Splunk logs and reports, micro-services deployment and provisioning using Spring Boot, Github and Jenkins, Trained and tutored junior co-workers.

positions.title: Senior Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack developer for the company's shopping cart software product. Developed enterprise modules for product subscriptions, payment gateways, and pricing lists. Spearheaded the adoption of Spock/ Grails as testing strategies. Improved user interface and UX, suggesting and prototyping the adoption of WebObjects and AngularJS services, controllers and directives.
Created and refactored a wealthy of Hibernate/JPA based typed queries/JQL/HQL, and made numerous performance refactorings for high-volume background DB querying jobs by extending a "jobs and events" framework built on top of Quartz scheduler.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Fulfilling the role of Senior Java Developer in a bilingual, international team of developers, QAs
and functional analysts covering 3 countries: Argentina, USA, and El Salvador. Contributing to the conception and development of a Camel-based integration application linking several different Point-of-sale (POS) applications, and databases, using ARTS standards. Also performing code reviews and being the reference person for Java programming best practices.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Alere - Marietta, GA February 2009 to May 2012
Part of a team migrating the company’s Wellness Portal (a .NET application with 4,000,000 users) to Oracle WebCenter. Providing meaningful backend data consumption (via Spring and REST Services) to portlets generated by WebCenter, and to UI pages in JQuery/JSP.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description: Redesigned the back-end and middle tier of the common Content Management System of 3 of Turner's networks: Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, and Toonami Jetstream, in replacement of an assortment of old Vignette CMS applications.

positions.title: Java Swing Developer
positions.description: Provided gap analysis expertise and development on a Swing-based Credit Score calculator. It consisted in a visual rule set design tool, to be used for credit companies in order to create decision sets. My main responsibilities consisted in bridging a gap between presentation and model, and applying refactoring when necessary.

positions.title: Developer/Functional Architect
positions.description: Gathered requirements for, conceived, designed and developed an HHRR data integration application for personnel action forms. The application interacted with PeopleSoft HRMS, Banner, and a proprietary CTG workflow application.

company.name: Georgia Southern Office of Career and Professional Development

positions.title: Full-stack Java Developer
positions.description: Developed a web-based content management system for branding of the commercial clients. The stored text and streams of image data in an Oracle database, and extended Struts’ resources capabilities to render those images by means of servlets and custom tags.

positions.title: Java Full-stack Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed the business and presentation tier of a custom Content Management system.		
Created Session Bean wrappers for business methods of the content management application. Advocated the use of Hibernate as our persistence layer, created and demonstrated sample applications applied to our persistence needs.

positions.title: Java Full-stack Engineer
positions.description: Extended the production system by adding Swing-based modules for "Quick Order Entry" (a CCR utility) and Parts Manager (catalog). Helped to extend the Borland datasets package to suit Franke's demanding business needs.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description: Collaborated with the development of presentation and business tiers of a web-based custom reporting tool. The application was able to generate reports pulled from the Williams corporate database in Tulsa and from Oracle Financials. The skills involved were Core Java, JSP, servlets, and JavaScript. I also added optimizations to the code of existing modules, applying data caching, tier separation and design patterns concepts.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Helped migrate registration and Staff directory applications from COBOL into J2EE. The job included code analysis, being able to identify functionalities and business processes with very scarce documentation available, and translate such functionalities into a JSP/Servlet/EJB environment hosted in BEA Weblogic.

positions.title: Visual Basic / SQL Server / Java programmer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Helped migrate 2 large client-server (VBasic) applications into a web-hosted environment. The applications allowed the managers of call centers to design and perform custom evaluations of the CCR's performances. The GUI design included both applets (AWT) and JSP/Servlets.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Collaborated in the design and development of an Internet Banking system to be implemented on Red Link's countrywide newtork. Developed several Visual Basic and client-server applications for interaction with proprietary TANDEM servers using X25 protocol, and VC++ routines with CGI script calls. Refactored existing code and normalized datawaehousing DBs in SQL Server.

projects.title: Hairaan
projects.description:
A website containing the videos and lyrics of songs in Hindustani (Hindi/Urdu) and Punjabi languages.
It shows not only the lyrics, but translations of my own, and clickable dictionary definitions for each word, plus its accidence (gender, number, case, tense, etc).
The project is written using Java 12 and Angular 8 Universal.
Each song is rendered using all scripts available for that language: Devanagari and Urdu Nastaliq for Hindustani songs, Gurmukhi and Shahmukhi for Punjabi songs.

allTitles: Visual Basic / SQL Server / Java programmer
